{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Location |name = Fremennik Slayer Dungeon |image = [[File:Fremennik Slayer Dungeon Entrance.png|300px]] |release = [[26 January]] [[2005]] |update = Slayer Skill |members = Yes |floors = 1 |location = [[Fremennik Province]] |race = Varies |music = [[The Slayer]], [[Masquerade]] |map = [[File:Fremennik Slayer Dungeon map.png|300px]] |type = dungeon |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{Relative location |location = Rellekka Slayer Dungeon |north = Mountain Camp |west = Golden Apple Tree |south = Sinclair Mansion |east = Troll Stronghold (location) }} The '''Fremennik Slayer Dungeon''', also known as the '''Rellekka Slayer Caves''' and the '''Fremennik Slayer Cave''', is a cave system found south-east of [[Rellekka]], featuring [[slayer monster]]s that can only be killed by players with the appropriate [[Slayer]] level. The monsters within require progressively higher levels as the player travels deeper into the caves. Players '''cannot''' set up a [[dwarf multicannon]] within the caves. Attempting to do so yields the chatbox message: {{mes|The air is too dank for you to set up a cannon here.}} ==Transportation== The entrance to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is east of [[Rellekka]] and north-east of [[Sinclair Mansion]] ({{Map|2797,3616|mtype=pin|type=maplink}}). There are several ways to reach the cave: *(Fastest method) Players may use the [[slayer ring]] to teleport next to the cave exit. *Players can get there via the [[fairy ring]]s (code {{Fairycode|AJR}}). This is also a fast way to bank in [[Zanaris]]. *Players can set out from Rellekka and head south-east past the [[Golden Apple Tree]]. **The [[Rellekka teleport|Rellekka home teleport]], [[Enchanted lyre]], or [[Fremennik sea boots]] can be used to quickly reach Rellekka, if the player meets the requirements to use them. *Players can travel south from the entrance to the underground city of [[Keldagrim]]. *The [[eagle transport system]] gets the player a bit to the north of the cave. *Players may teleport to [[Camelot]] and travel the road that leads north, taking a left at the first fork, which leads you towards Rellekka. There is a [[log balance (Fremennik Province)|log balance]] [[shortcut]] south-west of the cave, requiring 48 [[Agility]] to pass. ==Overview== '''Note:''' Everything but the [[kurask]] and [[cave crawler]]s are passive (although the Cave Crawlers are only aggressive to players with a Combat level of 46 and below). [[Dwarf multicannon|Cannons]] cannot be used in this cave because the air in the tunnel is too "humid". This cave contains several slayer monsters, each with its own chamber. #The first chamber contains eight [[cave crawler]]s (level 10 [[Slayer]] is required to kill them). This chamber also contains an [[Agility]] [[Strange floor (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon)|shortcut]] which, at level 43 Agility{{Boostable|yes}}, can be used to enter the [[pyrefiend]] area. These are level 23. #The second chamber contains seven [[rockslug]]s - level 20 Slayer and a [[bag of salt]] or [[brine sabre]] are required to kill them. These are level 29. #The third chamber contains seven [[cockatrice]]. They require level 25 Slayer and a [[mirror shield]] - without one, the player's stats (including life points) will be dangerously reduced. Furthermore, they commonly drop [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scrolls]]. These are level 37. #The fourth chamber contains thirteen [[pyrefiend]]s which can be killed at level 30 Slayer. They attack with a magic-based melee attack; therefore, wearing dragonhide or other high magic defence armour would be wise. The Agility shortcut here requires level 43 Agility, and leads back to the first chamber. Like cockatrice, these also drop medium clue scrolls. These are level 43. For players using magic and ranged, there is safespot near rocks on west. #The fifth chamber contains eight [[basilisk]]s which require level 40 Slayer and a mirror shield to kill. There is a small safespot against the west wall, one square north of the agility shortcut. (The safespot spans multiple squares, and can be utilised by standing directly adjacent to the zigzag pattern). From there, a player can safely attack any basilisk to the north. Engaging with a southern basilisk will allow them to reach the player. With level 61 Agility the player can use the agility shortcut to enter the [[turoth]] (seventh) chamber. Also, upon entering this chamber, the music will change from ''[[The Slayer]]'' to ''[[Masquerade]]''. These are level 61. #The sixth chamber contains ten [[Jelly|jellies]], which require level 52 Slayer to kill. As with pyrefiends, their attack is magic-based melee, so wearing dragonhide is strongly recommended. All monsters beyond and including these can drop [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue scrolls]]. These are level 78. #The seventh chamber contains twenty two [[turoth]], requiring level 55 Slayer to kill. They are immune to all attacks not dealt via leaf-bladed weaponry, [[broad arrows]], [[broad bolts]] or the [[Magic Dart]] spell. The Agility [[Crevice (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon)|shortcut]] requires level 61 Agility and leads back to the basilisk (fifth) chamber. The rocks on the east wall and the pathway to the kurask chamber may be used to safespot. #The eighth chamber contains five [[kurask]]. They require 70 Slayer to kill. Like turoth, they are immune to all damage not dealt via leaf-bladed weaponry, [[broad arrows]], [[broad bolts]] or the [[Magic Dart]] spell. '''These and the cave crawlers (in the first chamber, if you have combat level 46 or below) are the only aggressive monsters in this cave.''' There is a task-only area located above the steps. If players attempt to attack any of the kurask upstairs without a kurask Slayer task, [[Jelly (mountain troll)|Jelly]] will forbid them from doing so. {{LocationMonsterTableHead|showslayer=yes|showkillrequirement=yes}} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Cave crawler |image=Cave crawler (2).png |levels=6, 96 |slayerlevel=7 |slayerxp=5, 93 |spawns=15 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Rockslug |levels=29 |slayerlevel=20 |slayerxp=27 |killrequirement=[[Bag of salt]] or [[brine sabre]] |spawns=7 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Cockatrice |levels=37 |slayerlevel=25 |slayerxp=37 |killrequirement=[[Mirror shield]] |spawns=7 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Pyrefiend |levels=43 |slayerlevel=30 |slayerxp=45 |spawns=13 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Basilisk |levels=61 |slayerlevel=40 |slayerxp=75 |killrequirement=[[Mirror shield]] |spawns=8 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Jelly |levels=78 |slayerlevel=52 |slayerxp=75 |spawns=10 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Turoth |image=Turoth (lv 89).png |levels=83, 85, 87, 89 |slayerlevel=55 |slayerxp=76, 77, 79, 81 |killrequirement=[[Leaf-bladed weapons]], [[broad arrows]], [[broad bolts]] or [[Magic Dart]] |spawns=22 }} {{LocationMonsterTableLine |name=Kurask |levels=106 |slayerlevel=70 |slayerxp=97 |killrequirement=[[Leaf-bladed weapons]], [[broad arrows]], [[broad bolts]] or [[Magic Dart]] |spawns=5 (normal)
9 (task-only) }} {{LocationMonsterTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 30 July 2025 |update = Varlamore: Bug Fixes & More |change = Fixed an issue in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon where items dropped on certain tiles near the stairs were impossible to pick back up again. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 April 2025 |update = Poll 83: Castle Wars Update |change = You can no longer skip one of the shortcut obstacles in the Fremennik Slayer caves by interacting with a different obstacle. }} {{Subject changes |date = 8 May 2024 |update = Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes |change = The [[Agility]] level required to use the Strange Floor shortcut between the Cave Crawlers and Pyrefiends was reduced from 62 to 43. The Agility level required to use the Crevice shortcut between the Basilisks and Turoths was reduced from 81 to 61. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 December 2016 |update = Carol's Christmas |change = The Rellekka slayer cave has been extended to include Kurasks only killable when on a slayer task. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *When examining the cave entrance from the outside, the game text reads, {{Mes|Wow – it's a guinea pig! No, hang on, it's a cave.}}. This is a pun on the scientific family name for guinea pigs, ''"cavy"''. *The layout of the cave is backwards. One enters by walking east but then to progress through the caves, the player must go west. *Most of the monsters in the cave drop pieces of the [[Mystic_robes#Light|Light mystic robes]] set. *Similarly to the [[Slayer Tower]], all monsters in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon have a [[Superior slayer monster|superior]] variant. *With some positioning, it was possible to pass the strange floor shortcut by only jumping over one of the traps but this has since been patched. {{Slayer locations}} {{Fremennik Slayer Dungeon}} {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Fremennik Province]]
